task: Revive codex-orch-unified as the primary general orchestration runtime and harden the original Codex swarm path.

changes.summary: Added file-backed runtime state persistence and queued control request handling under runs/_runtime.
Hydrates from persisted runtime state, persists every state mutation, and blocks duplicate starts across processes.
Processes queued control requests, exposes requestSwarmControl, and adds guardrails for pause/resume/rewind dispatch.
Uses the shared control-dispatch path and returns queued request metadata.
Polls persisted swarm state so SSE stays current across processes, not just within one Node process.
Added direct status, pause, resume, and rewind commands alongside the interactive run mode.
Added explicit swarm control scripts and clarified Foundry as a separate dev path.
Added PowerShell status, pause, resume, and rewind entrypoints on top of the main swarm runner.
Rewrote the top-level workflow docs to make the Codex swarm the primary runtime and removed stale claims about missing graph/CI/test infrastructure.

performed: Read back all edited files for structural consistency.
Confirmed README no longer references the removed graph-dsl/vitest/ci/history claims at the top level.
Confirmed new CLI and PowerShell control surfaces are wired into the shared requestSwarmControl path.
verification.reason: External executables were not launchable from this tool environment.

outcome: codex-orch-unified now has a shared file-backed runtime/control layer and a corrected operator path, making it a more coherent starting point for a general Codex-oriented orchestrator.
